events.title: Akinator closure contract frozen
events.hypothesis: A constant number of Akinator questions is not required; polynomial total dialogue is sufficient.
events.formal_statement: If deterministic exact SAT is decided with total cost <= N^c for one fixed c on every CNF, then SAT in P and therefore P=NP.
events.next_gap: Find a universally available exact question/observable family with polynomial total cost and certified progress.

events.title: Exact Walsh wave is not a free observable
events.hypothesis: Low-degree exact SAT-indicator wave coefficients might be cheap enough to guide the Akinator.
events.formal_statement: For G=F AND (NOT y) with fresh y, W_G({y})=#SAT(F); exact computation of even this degree-1 coefficient is #P-hard.
events.next_gap: Search for exact observables weaker than model counting.

events.title: Exact semantic split balance is #P-hard
events.hypothesis: The Akinator can cheaply choose a question that balances satisfying witnesses.
events.formal_statement: Exact balance needs #SAT(F AND q) and #SAT(F AND NOT q); these counts are #P-hard in general.
events.next_gap: Use proof-carrying structural progress rather than exact entropy/model balance.

events.title: Branch-or-answer trilemma frozen
events.formal_statement: Every exact question must yield certified collapse, keep both live branches, or pay for an exact semantic answer; heuristic discard is forbidden.
events.next_gap: Bound total branch mass or exact-answer cost.

events.title: Akinator mapped to SAT backdoor depth
events.formal_statement: Without a semantic oracle, adaptive variable questions form a backdoor-style decision tree; a supplied depth-d tree with polytime leaves costs O(2^d poly(N)).
events.external_basis: Dreier, Ordyniak, Szeider, SAT Backdoors: Depth Beats Size (2022).
events.next_gap: Prove shallow/poly-amortized depth or find counterfamilies.

events.title: BASE0 exact observable portfolio frozen
events.next_gap: Kill or prove each rung without silent heuristic fallback.

events.title: Expander graph-PHP selected as first BASE0/O5 stress family
events.reason: Root has no unit propagation; bounded-degree pigeon clauses are non-Horn/non-Krom; connected expanders defeat component decomposition; known Resolution width/size lower bounds attack O5.
events.next_gap: Determine whether repeated bounded-width contractions can evade the width lower bound under adaptive contexts.

events.title: Bounded-width contraction to Resolution-width bridge
events.hypothesis: Repeated bounded-width contractions under partial assignments might evade a Resolution width lower bound.
formal_statement: Root-global width-w contractions concatenate into one Resolution derivation of width <= max(w0(F),w).
If F|rho has a width-w residual derivation, pure Resolution lifts it to a subclause of D OR B(rho) with width <= max(w0(F),w+|rho|).
A complete O5(w) adaptive tree of branch depth d compiles to Resolution width <= max(w0(F),w+d).
The compiled Resolution DAG has size O(total local Resolution lines + branch-composition events).
external_basis: Ben-Sasson and Wigderson, Short Proofs are Narrow — Resolution Made Simple, ECCC TR99-022 / JACM 2001.
Their graph-PHP width theorem gives W(PHP(G)) >= r*e/2 for suitable bipartite expanders.
consequence: For bounded-degree expander graph-PHP, W=Omega(n), so fixed/logarithmic-width O5 requires branch depth Omega(n).
By Resolution size lower bounds and transcript-to-Resolution compilation, O5 total work is 2^{Omega(n)} in the graph parameter.
Using only constant left degree, a safe explicit encoded-input upper bound is N=O(n^2 log n), hence a conservative input-relative lower bound 2^{Omega(sqrt(N/log N))}, still superpolynomial.
events.next_gap: Escalate beyond plain Resolution: identify the first stronger exact proof-carrying observable that can contract graph-PHP while retaining polynomial discovery and total-cost bounds.

events.title: Independent O5 finite-mechanics replay passed
events.meaning: CI independently confirms the finite context-lift/branch-composition mechanics and validates JSON syntax. It does not establish the external asymptotic graph-PHP lower bound.
events.next_gap: Use graph-PHP as a separator to determine whether O7/B2/ER provides a constructive escape and locate the cost of generating the required extension definitions.

events.title: Graph-PHP encoded-input map conservatively repaired
events.trigger: The prior shorthand N=O(n log n) implicitly required bounded right degree, while the imported expander statement explicitly supplied constant left degree only.
formal_statement: Constant left degree implies total edges O(n).
With right degrees r_h, collision clauses sum_h C(r_h,2) <= O(n^2).
Safe binary-identifier encoding bound: N=O(n^2 log n).
Thus 2^{Omega(n)} implies 2^{Omega(sqrt(N/log N))}, which remains superpolynomial.
events.old_claim_withdrawn: 2^{Omega(N/log N)} without a separately established bounded-right-degree construction
events.next_gap: O7/B2/ER separator: proof existence vs deterministic schema generation vs universal extension discovery.

events.title: O7/B2 constructive escape built on the same graph-PHP separator
events.hypothesis: Graph-PHP may remain hard even after allowing B2/Extended-Resolution extension definitions, or the required extension schema may itself be unavailable constructively.
external_basis: Cook's polynomial-size Extended Resolution proof for standard PHP, using the recursively generated x'_ph <-> x_ph OR (x_nh AND x_pn) schema.
Modern explicit description: Grosof, Zhang and Heule, Towards the shortest DRAT proof of the Pigeonhole Principle (2022).
our_components: Constant-overhead translation of Cook OR-AND macro into frozen B2 using signed AND gates.
B2 false-placeholder gadget for every non-edge variable, respecting abs(a)!=abs(b), with short pure-Resolution proof of falsehood.
Graph-PHP pigeon/collision axioms map to stronger subclauses of the full-PHP placeholder axioms.
Resolution strengthening/subsumption simulation: replacing every source premise by a derivable subclause preserves refutation with node-linear overhead.
complexity: strengthening transform linear in translated proof size
events.separator: The same canonical graph-PHP family is superpolynomial for O5/plain Resolution but has a deterministic polynomial family-specific B2 proof generator under O7.
events.new_gap: A known family-specific polynomial extension schema does not supply a universal deterministic schema selector for arbitrary CNF.

events.title: Independent O7 graph-PHP finite-mechanics replay passed
events.meaning: CI validates the finite B2 false gadget, Cook-macro encoding, stronger-axiom mapping and subsumption mechanics. The polynomial Cook ER theorem remains external, and universal B2 discovery remains open.
events.next_gap: Formalize and attack UNIVERSAL_B2_SCHEMA_SELECTION: how to select the right extension macros with deterministic polynomial total cost on arbitrary CNF without exhaustive sequence search.

events.title: O7 universal schema-selection naïve routes closed
events.hypothesis: A universal O7 selector might cheaply score candidate extensions by exact semantic usefulness or simply enumerate all short candidate sequences.
formal_statement: For arbitrary CNF H, define F_H={s OR C:C in H} union {t} and e <-> (s AND t). Then F_H union Def(e) entails e iff H is UNSAT.
Therefore exact candidate forcedness / exact death of branch e=0 is coNP-complete under a polynomial reduction.
If explicit schema enumeration keeps M_i live candidates at K stages, the number of sequences is product_i M_i; if M_i>=2 then at least 2^K.
Polynomially many candidates per stage do not imply a fixed-polynomial global search when K grows with N.
events.external_sanity: Known proof-complexity literature gives conditional non-automatability results for strong Frege systems under standard cryptographic assumptions; this is treated only as a conditional warning, not a theorem about P vs NP.
events.next_gap: Find a proof-carrying structural vocabulary whose candidate progress can be certified cheaply and whose selection is guaranteed to avoid exponential fallback on every CNF.

events.title: Independent O7 schema-selection barrier replay passed
events.meaning: CI confirms finite selector-lift and sequence-count mechanics. coNP-completeness remains an analytical reduction; the barrier applies to semantic forcedness scoring and explicit exhaustive schema enumeration, not to every possible structural selector.
events.next_gap: PROOF_CARRYING_STRUCTURAL_SELECTOR: a polynomially enumerable vocabulary V(F) with at least one cheaply certifiable progress action on every CNF and a deterministic polynomial selection rule.
